title: RAGScope: A Leakage-Controlled, Cost-Aware Evidence-Gating Protocol for RAG Hallucination Triage
abstract: arXiv:2609.39075v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems need inexpensive ways to route generated answers: accept low-risk outputs, review uncertain ones, and reserve strong verifiers for the expensive tail. We present RAGScope, a leakage-controlled protocol for evaluating local evidence gates that use only the task input, retrieved context, and answer text. The protocol combines context-grouped splits, fold-scoped preprocessing, group bootstrap intervals, deployment operating points, end-to-end runtime, and explicit source-shift stress tests. On three RAGTruth tasks, the enhanced gate RAGScope-E reaches 0.798 AUROC and 0.660 average precision (AP) in pooled grouped cross-validation. Its pooled AP exceeds ROUGE-L by 0.034 with a 95% context-group interval of [0.002, 0.064], although the AUROC gain is not significant and ROUGE-L remains stronger on data-to-text. translated_title: RAGScope：一种面向RAG幻觉分诊的防泄漏、成本感知的证据门控评估协议
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统需要低成本的方式来路由生成的答案：接受低风险的输出，审查不确定的输出，并将强大的验证器保留给代价高昂的尾部。我们提出了RAGScope，一个防泄漏的评估协议，用于评估仅使用任务输入、检索上下文和答案文本的本地证据门控。该协议结合了上下文分组划分、折内范围预处理、组自助法置信区间、部署操作点、端到端运行时以及显式的源偏移压力测试。在三个RAGTruth任务上，增强门控RAGScope-E在汇总分组交叉验证中达到0.798的AUROC和0.660的平均精度（AP）。其汇总AP超过ROUGE-L达0.034，95%上下文组置信区间为[0.002, 0.064]，尽管AUROC的提升不显著，且ROUGE-L在数据到文本任务上仍然更强。在前10%的审查预算下，RAGScope-E达到0.748的精确率；接受最低风险（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出防泄漏评估协议RAGScope，验证了仅利用任务输入、检索上下文和答案文本的轻量级证据门控能够以低成本对RAG生成答案进行幻觉风险分诊，在三个RAGTruth任务上达到0.798 AUROC和0.660 AP，并在前10%审查预算下实现0.748的精确率。
en_tdlr: RAGScope is a leakage-controlled evaluation protocol demonstrating that lightweight evidence gates using only task input, retrieved context, and answer text can triage RAG hallucination risk at low cost, achieving 0.798 AUROC and 0.660 AP on three RAGTruth tasks with 0.748 precision at a top-10% review budget.
